items.html: It is found that Malchut, now on weekdays in the Second Temple, although she is face to face, is from the chest and below, and does not suckle from the upper Hey; therefore she is called the lower Hey, because she does not suckle from the five [Sefirot]. And guard this introduction, regarding the matter of Bina expanding until the first Hod — when it is, and when it expands until the second Hod.
